companies.name: Athene
companies.definition: SRE: pre-tax operating earnings of the retirement business excluding market volatility and non-operating items, net of financing costs. Net spread: SRE as a percentage of average net invested assets, annualized; this is the figure Apollo quotes on its calls. Net investment spread: net investment earned rate plus strategic capital management fees, less total cost of funds (higher, as it is before operating and financing costs).
companies.scope: Apollo-owned; Bermuda: Athene Life Re and the ACRA / ADIP sidecars.

net_spread.label: Net spread (SRE ÷ avg net invested assets)

companies.name: Global Atlantic
companies.source: KKR quarterly earnings release, Insurance segment (Form 8-K exhibit)
companies.definition: KKR's Insurance segment (Global Atlantic) operating earnings: net investment income less net cost of insurance and general and administrative costs. Basis changes: KKR owned about 63% of Global Atlantic until 2 Jan 2024 and 100% after; from 2025 the measure is cash-based and excludes marks on investments. KKR does not disclose a spread percentage.
companies.scope: KKR-owned; Bermuda reinsurance entities and the Ivy sidecars.
companies.fallback_note: KKR doesn't post call transcripts on its own site, and third-party transcript sites are paywalled or bar automated reading, so these figures come from SEC filings only.

companies.name: Brookfield Wealth Solutions
companies.source: Brookfield Wealth Solutions quarterly results (Form 6-K exhibit)
companies.definition: Brookfield's distributable operating earnings across its annuity (incl. American Equity), P&C and life businesses. Not a spread-only measure; no consistent spread percentage is disclosed.
companies.scope: Brookfield; Bermuda reinsurance platform with American Equity, American National and Just Group.

companies.name: Corebridge Financial
companies.owner: Nippon Life stake; Blackstone & BlackRock mandates
companies.source: Corebridge quarterly earnings release, consolidated results (Form 8-K exhibit)
companies.definition: APTOI: company-wide operating income before tax (Individual and Group Retirement, Life, Institutional), excluding investment gains and losses, market-risk-benefit changes and the Fortitude Re funds-withheld results. Base spread income: base portfolio income less interest credited, excluding variable investment income; the spread line of the business.
companies.scope: Fortitude Re legacy reinsurance and its own Bermuda flow reinsurance (from 2024); merging with Equitable (all-stock, close expected by end-2026).

companies.name: F&G Annuities & Life
companies.definition: Adjusted net earnings attributable to common shareholders: net earnings excluding mark-to-market effects and other significant items. After tax; not a spread measure.
companies.scope: Blackstone asset-management partner; F&G Life Re (Bermuda) sold to Ancient effective 1 Mar 2026; Fort Green Re (Cayman) sidecar since Aug 2025.
